sequences.title: Stateful setup for Read/Write Multiple Registers
sequences.purpose: Use setup or sequential valid requests before the target operation so the final message lands in a deeper valid parser state.
sequences.expected_behavior: Both requests valid and accepted in sequence; final message benefits from prior successful state.
constraints_preserved: Prefer Modbus/TCP ADUs with a 7-byte MBAP header.
Use protocol identifier 0x0000 and keep MBAP length consistent.
Diversify unit identifiers, read/write/diagnostic and file-record functions.
sequences.issue_safety_notes: No copy of any historical crash payload; requests are fully canonical and valid per protocol specification.

sequences.title: Issue-guided analogue for Read Exception Status with addressed follow-up
sequences.purpose: Exercise a request shape that omits the usual address-and-count fields, then follow it with a normal addressed register read to probe safe parser state transitions related to issue evidence about assumptions on request body layout.
sequences.expected_behavior: The endpoint should either handle or cleanly reject the 0x07 request without desynchronizing the connection, then parse the subsequent valid 0x04 request for starting address 0x0000 and quantity 0x0007 as a normal addressed read.
constraints_preserved: Each ADU uses a 7-byte MBAP header.
Protocol identifier is 0000 in both messages.
MBAP Length is 0002 for the 0x07 request and 0006 for the 0x04 request, matching unit identifier plus PDU bytes.
The follow-up 0x04 request preserves documented Starting Address and Quantity of Registers fields.
The quantity 0x0007 is aligned with supplied issue evidence describing reads of 7 input registers from address 0.
All messages are complete and non-truncated.
sequences.issue_safety_notes: This is a safe structural analogue only. It preserves full MBAP framing and avoids the malformed short-frame collision patterns associated with historical parser over-read concerns.
